lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular pixel clusters organized in vertical columns posterior to the pectoral fin region, forming a non-uniform grid-like spatial arrangement.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with high-luminance blobs, creating a localized grid pattern most visible in the mid-to-posterior lateral sections.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature along the upper lateral flank characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient, with higher intensity pixels on the dorsal side and lower intensity pixels on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Approximately 5 to 8 discrete high-luminance blobs are visible within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, primarily clustered in the anterior and basal regions.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Trailing edge irregularities and small notches are visible on the posterior margins of the first dorsal fin and the upper lobe of the caudal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced surface caustics (refracted light patterns) are superimposed over the intrinsic patterning across the dorsal and upper-lateral surfaces.
